Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from City of Campbell River, about 163 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.2474, -127.04172, where the truck road ends (Kainum Main FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.2 km on Kainum Main FSR, Melanie Mainline FSR by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 260 m W, climb about 62 m.
Hunt: deer, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2016 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-12, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1D-deer-atv-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 1-12: about 546 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.10 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 62 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
